summary: The owner points to a tower already in the skyline as a reason to allow another one.
realLife: Penn Central argued that the Pan Am Building had already changed the outline behind Grand Central and that the proposed tower might give the terminal a better backdrop.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with owner, existing building, proposal. A question about the existing tower lets the applicant state its own argument.

turns.what: A commissioner accepts the owner's skyline argument for the distant view alone.
turns.pulledBy: The hearing includes photographs from both ends of the approach.
turns.writesBack: The finding names the closer view that still concerns the board.

turns.what: The owner withdraws a skyline photograph after a resident identifies the camera position as a private rooftop.
turns.pulledBy: The caption calls it a sidewalk view and the photographer confirms the rooftop location.
turns.writesBack: The hearing packet marks the photograph withdrawn.
